hero.eyebrow: Data & AI advisory — independent consulting, Québec, Canada
hero.title: BI audits and AI governance
hero.subtitle: We help BI and finance teams trace the numbers behind their reports — and we help teams deploying AI agents evaluate outputs, control costs, and decide when a person should step in.

services.title: Two ways we work
services.subtitle: The same method on both sides: follow a real number or decision through the system, examine the evidence, and show you what to fix first.

items.name: BI & Data Warehouse Audit
items.description: When two reports disagree or a warehouse is inherited, we trace a management indicator from source to report and hand back a prioritized findings register.
points: Source-to-report trace of a management indicator
Grain, joins, history, reconciliation, and ownership review
Prioritized findings register: evidence, exposure, effort

items.name: AI Governance & Architecture Review
items.description: Before an agent or assistant reaches production, we examine one workflow end to end — permissions, evaluation gaps, human approvals, and cost per task.
points: Workflow and control map with approval checkpoints
Cost per completed task and practical monitoring

items.name: From a BI audit
items.text: An executive summary, a source-to-report trace of one indicator, and a findings register your team can work from — for example, a report showing $44 in freight charges for two orders whose freight totals $20.

items.name: From an AI review
items.text: A control map showing which actions run unsupervised, where human approval belongs, and how cost per accepted task is measured — for example, which purchase requests an assistant may submit alone.

open_forcefield.title: Open ForceField
open_forcefield.description: Our open-source toolkit for LLM and agent control — the same primitives we deploy in client work, free on PyPI.

about.title: The practice
paragraphs: Agentic Governance is an independent consulting practice in data and AI. The work centers on one discipline: following an actual number or decision through a system — a warehouse, a report, an agentic workflow — and showing the owner what to fix first.
We build in the open: Open ForceField, the VS Code and JetBrains extensions, and the published benchmarks are the working toolkit behind our engagements.
